title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Wikimedia…
description: A Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Wikimedia Foundation MediaWiki SecurePoll Extension affecting versions 1.43, 1.45, 1.46, and 1.47. The issue arises from improper neutralization of input during web page generation in the ResultPage.js module. This vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.1. No patch or remediation information is currently provided.
